rationale: The description says personalization identifies suitable content through tests and aims to deliver customer experiences. Testing can be conventional, but no selection mechanism is described, leaving AI-dependent targeting unresolved; non_ai is the best-supported forced judgment.
evidence_spans: a personalization solution that makes it easy to identify your best content through tests that are easy to execute. So you can deliver the right experience to the right customer.
conflict_response: Personalization and choosing content for customers could be implemented through ordinary tests or AI-driven targeting. The text gives no method; I cannot resolve that ambiguity by inference, so the binary non_ai choice remains weak/forced rather than supported.
